welcome.subtitle: Your desk is set with books, theological tutors, original languages and the tools to produce your material. Before you walk in — what brings you here today?

intent.title: What brings you here today?
intent.subtitle: Pick the path that best matches your goal. We'll take you straight there and remember your choice to make better suggestions later.

exegesis-paper.title: Academic exegetical study
exegesis-paper.description: Deep analysis of a passage with academic rubric, verified citations and .docx export.
exegesis-paper.workflowTitle: How you'll work your exegetical study
exegesis-paper.workflowSubtitle: Four guided stages that end in a paper ready to hand in.

pickPassage.title: Pick your passage
pickPassage.description: Selector that understands biblical references and loads the base Greek (SBL GNT).

configureRubric.title: Configure the rubric
configureRubric.description: Define the assignment requirements: length, minimum bibliography, mandatory sections.

studyWithTutors.title: Study with tutors
studyWithTutors.description: Chat with the theological faculty to discuss translations, authors and conclusions.

exportDocx.title: Export .docx
exportDocx.description: Academic document with verified citations, ready to submit to the seminary.

exegesis-paper.confirmBody: Taking you to the academic wizard. You'll start by picking your passage (e.g. Hebrews 1:1-4) and the rubric your professor requires.

devotional-content.title: Devotional or blog post
devotional-content.description: Generate devotionals, reflections or short articles with your theological tutors.
devotional-content.workflowSubtitle: From idea to saved resource in minutes, without losing pastoral rigor.

pickTopic.title: Pick topic or passage
pickTopic.description: Start from a verse, a theme or a pastoral question.

chatFaculty.title: Chat with the faculty
chatFaculty.description: Your tutors help you frame angle, audience and tone.

generateDevotional.title: Generate the devotional
generateDevotional.description: Structured output — intro, exposition, application, call.

saveResource.title: Save and publish
saveResource.description: Lands in My Resources, ready to reuse, export or send to WordPress.

devotional-content.confirmTitle: Heading to the faculty to create your devotional
devotional-content.confirmBody: Taking you to chat with your tutors. Ask them for a devotional on a passage and we'll save it in My Resources to reuse or publish.

expository-series.title: Plan expository preaching
expository-series.description: Preach a whole book pericope by pericope with weekly plan and integrated study.
expository-series.workflowTitle: How you'll plan your expository series
expository-series.workflowSubtitle: From the whole book to the weekly sermon, without losing the inspired author's thread.

pickBook.title: Pick the book
pickBook.description: Define your series: Romans, Matthew, Hebrews — and how many weeks you have.

dividePericopes.title: Divide into pericopes
dividePericopes.description: Platform proposes a syntactic + thematic division for your series.

weeklyStudy.title: Weekly study
weeklyStudy.description: Each pericope opens with exegesis + tutors specialized in expository preaching.

sermonReady.title: Sermon ready
sermonReady.description: The study flows into the sermon. You arrive at the pulpit with everything linked.

expository-series.confirmBody: Taking you to the 5-pass wizard: book panorama → structural division → preachable pericopes → fidelity review. At the end we generate your weekly sermon plan.

counseling-course.title: Create a course or teaching material
counseling-course.description: Premarital counseling, discipleship, classes — with session plan and artifacts.
counseling-course.workflowSubtitle: Plan, sessions, materials and assignments — all from one place.

defineTopic.title: Define the topic
defineTopic.description: Premarital counseling, discipleship, theology class — your call.

generateSessions.title: Generate the plan
generateSessions.description: Structured session plan with objectives, key scriptures and dynamics.

createArtifacts.title: Create artifacts
createArtifacts.description: Slides, worksheets, questions and assignments for each session.

shareWithCouple.title: Share
shareWithCouple.description: Material ready to print, project or send to those you counsel.

counseling-course.confirmBody: The course generator (sessions + slides + assignments) is in build. We'll take you to the dashboard meanwhile.
